usedFor: 42min takes the bookings, and Zoom runs the webinar. A “New Booking” in 42min can run “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom so a person who picks a time is registered.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in 42min, then “Register Attendee for Webinar” in Zoom
bestTemplate.why: It registers the booker as soon as they pick a time, because the trigger is pushed. “Updated Booking Time” can run it too, but a reschedule is not a new registration.

watchOut: “Updated Booking Time” also feeds this action, so a reschedule could register the same person twice. Both triggers can be limited to one event type.
